subject: [PATCH v3 2/8] mm/page_alloc: snapshot the preferred zone against shrink rebuilds

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch fixes a kernel NULL pointer dereference bug by reading the preferred zone only once in the get_page_from_freelist function, rather than re-reading it at every use. This is necessary because concurrent zonelist rebuilds can null or replace the preferred zone slot. The patch ensures that a stale but valid zone is used instead of causing a crash.
